name: circrnadisease

download_files.note: Same content as the TXT file in spreadsheet form; TXT selected as the plugin source (plain-text, no pandas/openpyxl dependency needed)

Independent module: 7,159,865 mutation-circRNA co-occurrence records across 30 TCGA cancer types. Different entity/relation type (genomic variant x circRNA, not circRNA x disease). Excluded from this plugin — out of scope for the 'circRNA-disease associations' resource this evaluation targets; candidate for a separate future plugin.
Independent module: 2,962,504 CNV-circRNA records across 33 TCGA cancer types. Same exclusion rationale as circ2mut.

fields.name: title
fields.sample: Expression of linear and novel circular forms of an INK4/ARF-associated non-coding RNA correlates with atherosclerosis risk.

fields.name: description
fields.sample: Circular ANRIL (cANRIL) isoforms from the CDKN2BAS/ANRIL locus...

primary_key.field: circrna_id (fallback: circ_rna_name, then circrna_synonyms) + Disease_MONDO_id, composited
primary_key.type: custom (circBase-style circRNA label + MONDO disease ID)

restrictions: Non-commercial use only, per the paper's stated CC BY-NC license

paper_vs_reality.claim: 6,998 circRNA-disease entries (v2.0, as of the 2024 paper)
paper_vs_reality.observed: 15,423 rows in the live 'v3.0' bulk TXT file (13,122 unique circRNA-disease pairs after aggregating multi-evidence rows)
~4,970 unique non-empty circrna_id values (9,690/15,423 rows carry a circrna_id; the rest use circ_rna_name/synonym as fallback label) in the live v3.0 data

paper_vs_reality.claim: 330 disease types (v2.0), Disease Ontology (DO) standardized names
paper_vs_reality.observed: 656-657 unique Disease_MONDO_id values in the live v3.0 data; disease IDs are MONDO (not DO) in the actual downloadable file
67 distinct species_details values (including several viruses, e.g. Human papillomavirus 16/18, and non-human hosts), consistent with continued expansion beyond the paper's reported 12

paper_vs_reality.claim: CC BY-NC license (from PMC full text Data Availability framing)
paper_vs_reality.observed: No explicit license text found on the live site itself

risks: The live site now serves 'circRNADisease v3.0' bulk data rather than the exact v2.0 snapshot described in the cited NAR paper; entity counts and disease-ontology system (MONDO vs. DO) have both changed since publication. Ingesting the live file is still the correct choice (it is the current, most complete, most accessible data release of the same underlying resource) but the paper's exact statistics should not be quoted as ground truth for the ingested dataset.

37% of rows (5,733/15,423) lack a circrna_id and must fall back to circ_rna_name or circrna_synonyms for a circRNA label; 79 rows lack both a usable circRNA label and a MONDO id and are skipped by the parser.
No public API; bulk-download-only ingestion path.
No site-level license page; license claim rests solely on the paper's CC BY-NC statement.
